messages:
maria: FYI after the RBAC refactor landed, audit shows a KMS decrypt by workspace `shared-prod` used by org `acme-inc` — looks like a project->workspace inheritance leak. Anyone oncall? :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy rbacheck-refactor succeeded in prod at 08:12 UTC

sam: looking... grabbing logs https://internal/logs/20345

sam: log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T08:15:02Z KMS_DECRYPT key=projects/global/keys/kv-123 actor=svc-account@shared-prod roleBindings=[project:dev-team]
```

jess: that's odd — actor is from shared-prod but key is owned by acme-inc. Could be our "inherit scopes to projects" change in PR #1423

chris: I ran a quick RBAC query — binding rule `allowProjectParents` is true for archived orgs. Might be evaluating parent org incorrectly.

sec-oncall: oncall here, prioritizing. Mitigations: 1) remove binding `project:dev-team` globally 2) block KMS decrypt API for now via WAF rule 3) revoke all SA tokens for shared-prod.

maria: agree. I'll remove the binding and request token revocation. jess, can you open an incident ticket? :white_check_mark:

jess: created INC-2026-1145 and added runbook link https://internal/incidents/1145. I'll coordinate key rotation with infra.

sam: quick test after removing binding: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms.internal/decrypt` returned 403 from acme key. Good.

maria: noting fallout: one internal batch job from Analytics will fail. Chris, Sam, please identify failing jobs and file followups.

chris: already found 2 jobs — analytics-sync and billing-report. Will create follow-ups and set canary rollback plan.

sec-oncall: postmortem checklist: reproduce locally, write unit tests asserting no parent-scope inheritance, add audit alert for mismatched org/key owner, add e2e that simulates archived org.

jess: next steps: revert the `allowProjectParents` default to false, write migration to re-evaluate existing bindings, add an audit query: `select * from audit where action='kms.decrypt' and resource_owner!=actor_org`.

maria: thanks all. I'll update the customer-facing compliance note if we need to notify affected tenants. Leaving thread open for updates.
